title: Certainty Is Not Just Correctness: Rethinking Token-Level Certainty in LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.00296v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Token-level certainty is widely used as a proxy for correctness in LLM training and inference. However, the performance of certainty-based methods depends both on the information in certainty scores and on how those scores are used. We therefore directly assess certainty's predictive ability through controlled empirical evaluations across models and tasks. We distinguish two prediction targets: identifying questions a model is more likely to answer correctly and distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question. In our experiments, certainty is generally better at identifying questions a model is likely to answer correctly than at distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question. Certainty also varies systematically across token types and positions within words, reflecting local properties of words and text form. translated_title: 确定性不仅仅是正确性：重新思考大语言模型推理中的词元级确定性
translated_abstract: 词元级确定性在大语言模型（LLM）的训练和推理中被广泛用作正确性的代理指标。然而，基于确定性的方法的性能既取决于确定性分数中所包含的信息，也取决于这些分数的使用方式。因此，我们通过跨模型、跨任务的控制性实证评估，直接考察确定性的预测能力。我们区分了两个预测目标：识别模型更有可能正确回答的问题，以及区分模型对同一问题的正确与错误回答。实验表明，确定性在识别模型可能正确回答的问题方面，普遍优于在区分同一问题下正确与错误回答方面的表现。确定性在词元类型和词内位置上也呈现系统性变化，反映了词和文本形式的局部特性。关于问题难度的信息在生成早期就会出现，而较弱的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文通过控制性实证评估指出，词元级确定性更擅长识别模型可能正确回答的问题，而不擅长区分同一问题下的正确与错误回答，因此确定性不应被简单等同于正确性。
en_tdlr: Through controlled empirical evaluations, this paper shows that token-level certainty is better at identifying questions a model is likely to answer correctly than at distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question, arguing that certainty should not simply be treated as a proxy for correctness.
